title: DOW-UAP-D077, AARO Unresolved Case Analysis Update: Western United States Event
doc_notes: This document is an AARO memorandum providing an analysis update on a UAP event involving multiple sightings of orbs in the western United States in October 2023.

incidents.summary: Six federal law enforcement agents observed luminous orange mother orbs releasing smaller red orbs over a two-day period.
incidents.explanation: Approximately 60 percent of activity is plausibly attributed to military infrared flares; 40 percent remains unresolved.
incidents.quote: luminous orange “mother orb” appeared to produce smaller red “orbs,” one after another
